metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.required_rule: Every required dependency must be explicitly present and compatible.
semantics.optional_rule: Optional dependencies remain optional and are never auto-enabled.
semantics.cycle_rule: Dependency cycles follow explicit graph-safety policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Invalid boot graph hard-fails before affected capability activation.
semantics.remediation_rule: Error UX returns a concise actionable remediation derived from the actual missing/conflicting dependency.
semantics.no_guess_rule: Validator never guesses a substitute capability.

invariants.rule: Boot selection, pruning, dependency validation and activation are explicit; the runtime never silently enables missing dependencies.

hard_gates.condition: required dependency absent but activation continues
error remediation unrelated to actual dependency failure

references.purpose: Boot graph uses explicit dependency semantics.
